title: Native SQLite repositories and migrations
summary: Original SQLDelight Kotlin/JVM+iOS and GRDB Swift repository profiles with transactions, parameterized queries and versioned SQLite migration fixtures.

profiles: Linux x86_64, Python 3.12.14 / SQLite: 2 tests passed for the original schema, additive migration, constraints and transaction rollback.
notes: Python SQLite success does not establish Kotlin or Swift compilation. Gradle/Kotlin, Swift and Xcode were unavailable; native profiles are unexecuted.
SQLDelight 2.4.1 / Kotlin 2.4.21 and GRDB 7.11.1 / Swift 6.1+ are pinned source profiles. Select a compatible Gradle version and commit native dependency locks after verified resolution.
Kotlin/iOS compilation additionally requires macOS/Xcode: gradle -p kotlin compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64.
The version-one schema database is an original Genlib fixture, not third-party data. Host owns database lifecycle, migrations, backups, encryption and concurrency.
